title: show hides open children behind the eight-child display cap
outcome: show lists open children before completed ones and says how many more exist, so a required open child is never invisible
acceptance: show on an item with more than eight children prints every open child and a (+N more) marker for the rest

completion.summary: Prioritized unfinished direct children in bounded focus/show relations, added exact omitted-child counts and typed unfinished/terminal omission reasons, preserved rich child summaries, and covered both the one-open-behind-terminal case and the 128-open-child response ceiling.
